thread:
olga: Hey team — opened a PR to add Central Asia / CIS availability notes + Java and .NET SDK examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/2754. Also added a short migration note for customers currently using a config file to switch to env var or regional domain. Need legal + runtime wording check before I merge.

ben: thanks. can we show both patterns? we usually prefer env var REDWOOD_REGION but a brief example of a per-project config file is helpful for self-hosted/private customers. Also add a one-line explanation that region selection can affect latency and fallback behavior.

olga: added both. Java snippet:
```java
// java example
System.setProperty("REDWOOD_REGION", "eu-cis-1");
RedwoodClient client = new RedwoodClient(System.getProperty("REDWOOD_API_KEY"), System.getProperty("REDWOOD_REGION"));
var resp = client.generate("hello");
```
.NET snippet:
```csharp
// dotnet example
Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable("REDWOOD_REGION", "eu-cis-1");
var client = new RedwoodClient(apiKey: Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("REDWOOD_API_KEY"), region: Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("REDWOOD_REGION"));
var r = await client.GenerateAsync("hi");
```
Config-file example (legacy customers): `redwood.config.json` with `{ "region": "eu-cis-1" }` and note to migrate to env var or constructor param.

ved: eng-runtime: confirm routing/behavior? We have regional domains like api.eu-cis-1.redwood.ai. We also accept X-Redwood-Region header for older clients. KV/prefix caches are cluster-local; for Dedicated/Private they're region-local unless replication requested. Hosted may read from another region in failover; add that note. Also embeddings and streaming follow same routing rules.

legal: copy check — avoid promises like "data stays only in-region". Suggested safe phrasing: "For Hosted plans, customer content is processed and stored in the selected region where available. For Dedicated and Private deployments, residency can be provided via contractual terms (see Data Processing Addendum: https://redwood.example.com/dpa). Some operational telemetry, backups, or diagnostic logs may be processed outside the selected region; see the DPA for details." Add a short footnote about cached logs not being replicated cross-region by default.

olga: updated PR with legal wording + footnote and added migration curl examples:
```bash
# preferred: regional domain
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.eu-cis-1.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hola"}'
# legacy header fallback
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "X-Redwood-Region: eu-cis-1" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hola"}'
```
Also added migration checklist: update SDK to latest minor (region param), prefer env var, switch to regional domain, remove header when fully migrated, notify ops about KV cache locality expectations.

docs-bot: Docs CI: ✅ 3/3 checks passed (links, lint, preview). Preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/pr-2754

ben: LGTM. tiny nit: add a one-line pointer to Dedicated onboarding contact for contractual residency and a note to reach out if customers need region-specific SLAs.

olga: added contact link and will merge once CI green. thanks everyone! :party_popper:
